entities.summary: Lord Nicholas Charles Edward Jonathan Windsor is a relative of the British royal family, the youngest child of Prince Edward, Duke of Kent. As a Catholic convert, he forfeited his right of succession to the throne. Lord Nicholas has voiced strong anti-abortion views.
